actionsandevents_actions_modal_option_tr: How does this work?

This feature allows you to execute Minecraft commands in your Minecraft Game Client (Mod required) or Minecraft server (ServerTap extension required). You can enter all Minecraft commands that are available in the Minecraft console. To execute multiple commands, write each command on a new line. To connect to your Minecraft client or server, navigate to "Setup" => "Minecraft Connection" and follow the steps.

It is also possible to import predefined commands from templates. This will save you the trouble of creating the commands :)

Remember that you can use the placeholder parameters to dynamically insert values. So you can use {username} for example to create textures that contain the name of the gifter.

Example Command to summon a zombie:
execute at {playername} run summon zombie ^ ^ ^5
Minecraft command documentation: https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Commands. You can also receive help on our discord server.
How does this work?

You can control for example your smart devices via WebHooks or send automated messages in your Discord Server.

IFTTT - If This Then That

To control smart devices, you need to create an account on IFTTT.com. Then create a new applet and select "WebHook" as trigger ("If This").

Possible use cases
  • Viewers can play or skip songs on Spotify
  • Viewers can turn the lights in your room on and off
  • And much more...

Where do I find my WebHook URL?

Navigate to https://ifttt.com/maker_webhooks/ and click on "Documentation". There you will find the URL with your key. You have to replace {event} with the name of your previously created event.

Which parameters are passed?
  • value1 - The username of the event trigger
  • value2 - The text behind the command (if event = command)
  • value3 - The name of the gift (SKU) (if event = gift)

Discord - Send automated messages

To send automated messages to your discord server, follow the official instructions from Discord: Intro to Discord Webhooks

Can I also use WebHooks from other services?

Yes, but it depends on the structure of the required web request. At the moment we have only tested it with IFTTT and Discord.

This feature not only enhances viewer interaction but also encourages more gifting during your streams.

This overlay is a great way to acknowledge your top supporters in real-time, making them feel valued and appreciated.

seo_snippets_goals_instructions: In order to use the Goal Overlays you need to start your TikTok Livestream and then connect TikFinity and make sure you have implemented the Goal overlay into Live Studio or OBS.
seo_snippets_goals_intro: What goals do you have in your broadcast? Define Like, Share or Follow goals in the form of progress indicators. To include the goals in OBS (Browser Source) or LIVE Studio (Link), simply copy the URLs.
seo_snippets_index_about_description: TikFinity was created by Zerody and is now developed and maintained by a dedicated team. We are not affiliated with TikTok. Our mission is to make TikTok streaming more interactive, fun, and engaging for creators and viewers.
seo_snippets_index_description: TikFinity is the most popular streaming tool for TikTok LIVE. Pimp your live stream with interactive widgets for TikTok LIVE! Automatically play sound alerts when you receive gifts or include professional overlays in Live Studio. We offer countless possibilities for interactive TikTok streams for free!
seo_snippets_index_emote_description: You can now use your Sub Emotes as event triggers for Sound Alerts and Actions. This way you can offer amazing perks to your subscribers.
seo_snippets_index_game_integrations_des:
Especially popular are our game integrations for Minecraft and GTA 5.
Viewers can control the games by sending gifts and spawning NPCs in the game.
By letting viewers control your stream, you can increase your TikTok LIVE revenue because viewers love to interact with the stream!
Our tool is comparable to Streamlabs and perfectly optimized for TikTok LIVE.
You can implement our features in TikTok LIVE Studio, OBS Studio, Streamlabs OBS, and other streaming software.
Our Tools for TikTok LIVE are free to use and easy to set up.
seo_snippets_index_gta5_description: Let your viewers control your GTA 5 game! With the new GTA 5 TikFinity Plugin, your viewers can trigger different actions in the game by sending gifts! Watch Tutorial
seo_snippets_index_interactive_tools_des: TikFinity offers you a wide range of free interactive features for your Live Stream on TikTok. From our most popular features such as Text-to-Speech (TTS) and Sound Alerts up to IFTTT integrations for Smart Devices. We have something for everyone! Join us and transform your TikTok LIVE into a dynamic and immersive adventure!
seo_snippets_index_interactive_tools_sub: You can maximize your audience and improve your viewers' engagement with little effort.
seo_snippets_index_keystroke_description: You want to allow your viewers to remotely control any Windows applications with gifts? Check out the new Keystroke Simulation feature available in Actions & Events! Watch Tutorial
seo_snippets_index_level_description: With the new TikTok Team Member Levels, you can now give your most loyal viewers additional benefits with Text-To-Speech and Actions & Events!
seo_snippets_index_minecraft_description: You like to stream Minecraft? Our Minecraft integration offers your viewers an interactive experience. Your viewers can control Minecraft through gifts and other events! Watch Tutorial
seo_snippets_index_streamerbot_descripti: Try our new Streamer.bot integration to create even more interactive features and to connect other platforms. Read the tutorial!
seo_snippets_index_timer_description: You have a lot of time to stream? Great! Let your viewers decide how long you have to stream. Your viewers can extend a countdown with gifts! Watch Tutorial
seo_snippets_index_voicemod_description: Let your viewers change your voice with the new Voicemod integration! Available in the Actions!
seo_snippets_obsoverlays_description: Here you can find the general overlays for integration into OBS (Browser Source) or LIVE Studio (Link). All functions are divided into individual widgets to achieve the best possible flexibility in alignment. To include the overlays listed below in Live Studio, copy the URL and paste it into a new Link Source.
seo_snippets_obsoverlays_instructions: To make the overlays work, you need to start your TikTok Livestream and then connect TikFinity. Make sure that the overlay is visible in OBS or Live Studio.
seo_snippets_obsoverlays_intro: Our widgets are optimized for TikTok LIVE Studio and OBS. Create breathtaking animations and mini-games that can be controlled by your viewers.
seo_snippets_songrequests_engagement: This is a great way to get your viewers involved in your stream and make them feel like they are part of the experience. You can also use this feature to play music that your viewers want to hear, which can help keep them engaged and entertained.
seo_snippets_songrequests_instructions: In order to use the Song Requests feature you need to sign-in with your Spotify Account. Then start your TikTok Livestream and connect TikFinity. Make sure that the Song Requests option is enabled on the Song Requests Configuration Page.
seo_snippets_songrequests_intro: With this feature your viewers can request and skip songs on Spotify! Simply play your favorite playlist and your viewers can interact with it. The requested songs will be added to your Spotify playback queue!
seo_snippets_sounds_gifts_description: Here you can automatically play sounds when you receive gifts, followers, shares, and sub emotes in your TikTok LIVE stream. To do this, select an event here and then choose the sound. You can upload your own sounds or use the predefined ones.
seo_snippets_sounds_gifts_title: Play Sounds for Gifts on TikTok LIVE
seo_snippets_sounds_instructions: In order to play sounds automatically you need to start your TikTok Livestream and then connect TikFinity. Make sure that the Sound Alerts option is enabled on the Sound Alerts Configuration Page.
seo_snippets_sounds_intro: Play sounds when you receive gifts, followers, subs and more! Be creative and create sounds for your favorite gifts and your audience will love to support you!
seo_snippets_sounds_random: This is the easiest way to play sounds when you receive gifts, follows or other things. If you map multiple sounds to the same trigger, a sound will be randomly picked.
seo_snippets_sounds_see_also_description: Text-to-Speech for TikTok LIVE is available on this page.
seo_snippets_tts_advanced_description: For even more flexibility, you can use Text-to-Speech through our Actions & Events feature. For example, have gifts, followers, or sub-emotes read aloud automatically to highlight special moments. This integration allows you to customize your stream and strengthen your audience engagement, which can boost your TikTok LIVE revenue.
seo_snippets_tts_advanced_title: Advanced TTS Features with Actions & Events
seo_snippets_tts_chat_description: With TikFinity, you can have your viewers' chat comments read aloud in real-time using Text-to-Speech (TTS). The voices are played directly in the browser – no overlay required! Customize the volume, language, or voice to add a personal touch to your TikTok LIVE stream. This feature is perfect for boosting interaction with your audience and making your stream unforgettable.
seo_snippets_tts_chat_title: Read chat comments on TikTok LIVE out loud automatically
seo_snippets_tts_description: Here you can read out the chat comments from your viewers automatically via Text-to-Speech (TTS). The voice is played directly in the browser. No Overlay is required! A TTS feature is also available via Actions & Events which offers more flexibility. (e.g. Read out gifts)
seo_snippets_tts_instructions: To make the bot read out the chat comments, you need to start your TikTok Livestream and then connect TikFinity. Make sure that the TTS option is enabled on the TTS Configuration Page.
seo_snippets_tts_intro: Let your chat comments be read out by our AI voices! Turn it into a benefit for your top supporters and enjoy additional support from your audience!
seo_snippets_tts_see_also_description: Sound Alerts for, e.g., gifts are available on this page.
seo_snippets_tts_voices_description: Make your viewers laugh with fun AI voices! Choose from a variety of voices, from humorous to unique character voices, and assign them to specific users or events. This feature is ideal for offering exclusive perks to special supporters like subscribers or team members, making your TikTok LIVE stream more interactive and entertaining.
seo_snippets_tts_voices_title: Funny AI Voices for More Entertainment
seo_software_description: TikFinity is a free streaming tool for TikTok LIVE, available as a desktop and web application, offering numerous interactive features such as Sound Alerts, Text-to-Speech, overlays, game integrations (Minecraft, GTA 5), and more, which can be controlled by viewers.

setup_coin_reset_desc: Use the Challenge-Feature to reset all points temporarily to 0 (e.g. during a challenge). Use the Halving-Feature with a percentage of 100% to finally reset all points and keep the levels. Use the following buttons to reset the Points and Levels by criteria or of all users:

setup_desc: Here you can define the basic settings.
setup_error_generic: An error has occurred. Please repeat the operation.
setup_error_missing_session: You don't seem to be logged in to TikTok. Please log in into your TikTok Account and try again.

setup_level_desc: Viewers can increase their level by collecting points. In Level Points you set how many points are required to reach the next level. Furthermore, there is a level multiplier, which increases the number of points required with each level. As a result, the number of points required to reach the next level increases exponentially.
setup_mc_connection_desc:
Control Minecraft via TikFinity to summon Mobs or execute custom commands. To do this use the option "Exec Minecraft Command" in your Actions. This requires the official TikFinity Mod installed in your Minecraft Client
or the plugin ServerTap on your Minecraft Server (Bukkit, Spigot or PaperMC)!
setup_mobile_voucher_desc: You can redeem this code in the mobile app to get the pro features.
setup_obs_connection_desc:
You can control OBS via TikFinity to switch scenes and sources automatically on certain events. To do this use the options "Switch Scene" or "Activate Source" in your Actions. This requires OBS 28 or newer! In OBS click "Tools" > "WebSocket Server Settings" and enable the Websocket Server.
Then click on "Show Connect Info" and enter the connection details here.
Please note that the IP is always 127.0.0.1 if OBS is running on the same system as TikFinity.
setup_streamerbot_connection_desc: Streamer.bot is one of the most popular tools for streamers! With the TikFinity integration you can trigger your Streamer.bot Actions via TikFinity Actions & Events. Please activate the Websocket Server in Streamer.bot in the "Servers/Clients" tab to establish a connection. See Setup Instructions for more information.
setup_subscriber_bonus_desc:
If you have subscribers, you can set a points multiplier for them.
Then your subscribers will get more points for their activities.

In addition, settings that exceed the limits of the Free version may be lost.

songrequests_desc:
With this feature your viewers can request and skip songs on Spotify! Simply play your favorite playlist and your viewers can interact with it. The requested songs will be added to your Spotify playback queue! Setup the Song Requests Overlay to display your current playlist! Setup the Command Info Overlay to display the command results!

Commands

!play [Song - Artist] - Add song to queue !revoke - Revoke requested song from queue !skip - Skip current track
